items.title: Resonance
items.hint: Hover or focus to stir the ribbons.
items.installNote: Install three and copy resonance.tsx and resonance-scene.ts. Give the parent a defined height. colorPalette is a three-colour hex tuple for ribbons, inner light and aura.
items.brief: Integrate Resonance, a Motiqo harmonic resonance ring on pure black. Keep a dark empty core surrounded by 30 to 45 closed luminous blue ribbon loops. Combine slowly evolving angular harmonics and phase offsets to form silky interleaving folds, with additive electric blue and pale blue light accumulating into an incandescent inner rim. Render a faint cobalt glow and 35,840 tiny stippled aura points in deformed concentric rings, fading out and expanding slightly upwards. Animate ribbon geometry and aura entirely in vertex shaders with static GPU buffers, one 60Hz requestAnimationFrame and no per-frame React renders. Hover and keyboard focus smoothly increase agitation. Expose size, speed, waveAmplitude, ribbonCount, colorPalette as a three-colour tuple, intensity, compact and paused. Include a static fallback, reduced motion, hidden/offscreen suspension, context restoration, responsive DPR-capped rendering and complete GPU and listener cleanup.

items.title: Sleeve
items.hint: Scroll or drag to browse. Open an album; select the lower stack or press Escape to return. Arrow keys browse.
items.installNote: Install motion and copy sleeve.tsx, sleeve-cover.tsx and sleeve-math.ts. Give the parent a defined height. The twenty default album covers are authored SVG graphics. Supply albums with id, artist, title, artwork URL or colours, and connect onPlay to your player.
items.brief: Integrate Sleeve, a Motiqo vinyl collection in a rounded portrait wireframe screen cropped at its lower edge like Luma. Twenty authored artistic album covers form a perspective crate with 1000px perspective, preserve-3d, bottom-centre transform origin, -28 degree X tilt, progressive scale, vertical spacing and deep separation shadows. Wheel and vertical drag browse continuously with bounded inertia. Motion spring generators preserve velocity and introduce small per-card delays and a directional fan opening. Add a brief Y-axis yaw and Z-axis roll during reinsertion, returning to the exact resting pose. Cards passing the front descend below the clipped lower edge. Selecting an album lifts it to a flat hero position; the other cards compress into a lower stack. Crossfade the collection heading and album count to artist and title. Reveal a circular translucent Play button and a white PLAY ALBUM pill; onPlay is the host playback callback, with no bundled audio. Clicking artwork or the lower stack, or Escape, returns the hero to its exact original position without changing scroll. Accept albums, tiltAngle, springConfig, initialIndex, onPlay, compact and paused. Include keyboard browsing, reduced-motion static transitions, offscreen/hidden suspension, responsive sizing and full cleanup. No external assets required for defaults. Use SVG authored cover graphics, CSS 3D transforms, React and Motion; update DOM refs in one 60Hz RAF without per-frame React renders.

items.title: Meridian
items.hint: Scroll to follow the route in either direction. Autoplay resumes after 2.5 seconds. Click or Space to replay.
items.installNote: Install three and copy meridian.tsx, meridian-scene.ts, meridian-city.ts and meridian-math.ts. Three.js includes the postprocessing passes. Give the parent a defined height. Increment replay to restart the sequence.
items.brief: Integrate Meridian, a Motiqo cinematic neon routing city in a fine-bordered rounded container. Build 30 varied raised sidewalk islands around a wide avenue with a diagonal dogleg and intersecting streets, with compound stepped buildings, recessed terraces, L-shaped wings, bevels and rooftop equipment. Use architectural #0d0f14, roughness .35 and metalness .65. Preserve the cyan/magenta route shader, HDR tip, UnrealBloomPass strength 1.05 radius .65 threshold .85, and eight dynamic route PointLights. Trace the main route then a cyan/electric-blue/violet/magenta right-angle detour along clear streets. One normalized timeline drives both route progress and smooth camera tracking. Start with an approximately 1.8-second high/far/rotated exponential-out camera descent into a close three-quarter view. Autoplay loops by default. Wheel over the canvas scrubs forwards/backwards immediately; after 2.5 seconds idle, autoplay gently resumes from the same progress. Expose autoPlay, scrollSensitivity, cinematicIntro, primaryRouteColor, incidentColor, detourGradient as a four-colour tuple, animationSpeed, numeric replay, compact and paused. Include replay by click or Space, reduced motion, offscreen/hidden suspension, context restoration and complete GPU cleanup. No remote map data or assets.

items.title: Deck
items.description: A little circuit, brought to life.
items.hint: Hover a key to lift it. Touch the centre for a cascade. Click to pin; arrows explore, End selects the touchpad and Escape releases.
items.installNote: Install motion, then copy deck.tsx and deck-math.ts into one folder. Give the parent a defined height. Colors is a tuple of four hex colours. The artwork stays #08080a in either site theme.
items.brief: Integrate Deck, a Motiqo isometric CAD hardware deck over #08080a. Four banks of 4 by 4 rounded keys have geometric circle, diagonal square, line and dot glyphs. A large central touchpad contains three concentric circles. Use precise 2:1 isometric projection and thin 1px non-scaling strokes. Hover lifts a key along the world Z axis, leaving a dashed ground ring and four vertical dashed projection lines. Its iridescent lime/cyan/violet/gold outline lights up along with dim proximity outlines on adjacent keys. A two-tier floating cylinder follows the selected key through velocity-preserving Framer Motion springs; its solid #08080a top and walls occlude underlying lines. The touchpad lights all three rings and starts staggered key elevation waves across the adjacent banks; pinning a key also triggers the sequence. Perimeter circuit paths carry moving data pulses. Include auto-play when no target is selected, click/touch pinning, arrow-key selection, Home/End, Enter and Escape. Expose colors as a four-colour tuple, springSpeed, speed, elevation, autoPlay, compact and paused. Use one 60Hz RAF with Motion analytic spring generators and SVG refs, no per-frame React renders. Hit-test stationary footprints to avoid hover flicker as keys lift. Preserve responsive letterbox-aware coordinates, static reduced motion, hidden/offscreen suspension, matching thumbnail and complete RAF/observer/listener cleanup. Keep geometry, physics and activity math in deck-math.ts and rendering/lifecycle in deck.tsx.

items.title: Sentiment
items.description: The changing shape of a market.
items.hint: Move to inspect. Change the period to morph the curve. Arrow keys explore; Space replays.
items.installNote: Copy sentiment.tsx. React is the only dependency. Give its parent a defined height. Supply your own series of price, volume, sentiment and label values, or explore the illustrative Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana series.
items.brief: Integrate Sentiment, a self-contained Motiqo market chart inspired by the supplied chart reference. A restrained dark card contains the asset title, price, volume and sentiment metrics, five period tabs and a fine SVG line coloured from green highs to muted red lows with a diffused area fill. Progressively draw the line and count up the price. Morph between periods and asset data through exponential interpolation without remounting the animation loop. A smoothly interpolated pointer marker stays on the displayed curve and a bounded tooltip reveals date, price, sentiment and volume. Include illustrative Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana data, clearly labelled as illustrative, and accept custom series. Expose asset, range, onRangeChange, series, amplitude, speed, strokeWidth, fillOpacity, compact and paused. Normalize custom series and guard flat or invalid values. Preserve matching miniature, light and dark themes, keyboard inspection, Space replay, static reduced motion, offscreen/hidden suspension and complete RAF/observer/listener cleanup. Target 60Hz using SVG refs without per-frame React renders. Exclude the external scene and background of the reference.

items.title: Companion
items.hint: Move your cursor and its eyes follow. Click or Enter for a playful laugh. Arrow keys steer; Space pauses or resumes.
items.installNote: Install three and copy companion.tsx. Give the parent a defined height. No images or external assets are required.
items.brief: Integrate Companion, a Motiqo animated visual agent. Render a translucent three-dimensional orb made from five broad curved iridescent membranes around a softly shaded green-blue face. Use warm coral/orange above, violet at the side and cyan below, with fine grain and luminous edges. Two white capsule eyes follow the mouse across the page through bounded exponential interpolation. Click or Enter triggers a brief playful laugh: a soft vertical bounce, volume-preserving squash and stretch, a small tilt, squinting eyes and a membrane ripple. Repeated clicks blend continuous reaction envelopes without snapping the current pose. Respect interactive, paused, reduced motion and compact preview settings. Add a gentle natural blink and coherent travelling waves, spherical curvature and layered folding across the front of the face with soft feathered membrane edges. Use static parametric BufferGeometry and procedural shaders with surface normals, a depth-tested core and additive translucent ribbons. Expose speed, intensity, eyeResponse, warmColor, coolColor, interactive, compact and paused. Preserve matching SVG fallback, Space playback, arrow-key gaze, Home reset, reduced-motion static output, offscreen/hidden suspension, scrolling-aware pointer coordinates, context restoration and full geometry/material/renderer/context/RAF/observer/listener cleanup. Target 60Hz and clamp DPR. Exclude surrounding interface, text, branding and menus.

items.title: Helix
items.description: The shape of life, in motion.
items.hint: Move to stir the particle strands. Space pauses; arrow keys steer the disturbance.
items.installNote: Install three (and @types/three for TypeScript), then copy the self-contained helix.tsx file. Give its parent an explicit height. Colors is a tuple of three hex colours, from upper violet through pink to lower cyan.
items.brief: Integrate Helix, the self-contained Motiqo 3D particle DNA component. Use only THREE.Points, BufferGeometry and a custom ShaderMaterial: 30,000 to 60,000 mathematically seeded points form two intertwined strands with 32 internal rungs and organic initial jitter. Incline the longitudinal axis from upper left to lower right over a clean #08080a background. Rotate continuously around that axis. Implement analytic-gradient 3D noise fields and their curl in the vertex shader, creating smooth organic disintegration that expands and returns in a seamless slow loop without losing the double helix. A local pointer/touch disturbance increases dispersion, with exponentially interpolated input. Use violet #7c3aed, pink #ec4899 and lower cyan #06b6d4, additive soft circular sprites, depthWrite false and perspective point sizing. Expose particleCount, rotationSpeed, dispersionStrength, colors as a three-colour tuple and interactive, plus compact and paused. Keep geometry static between count changes; drive motion with uniforms, target 60Hz, cap DPR, provide SVG fallback and keyboard input, freeze for reduced motion, suspend offscreen/hidden, restore context, and dispose all geometries, material, renderer, GL context, RAFs, observers and listeners. The component contains its shaders, styling and geometry generation in one file. Exclude all website text, controls, branding and menus from the supplied video.

items.title: Holdings
items.hint: Select a company to inspect its allocation. Space replays the reveal.
items.installNote: Copy holdings.tsx. React is the only dependency. Give the parent a defined height. Pass holdings as an array of name, ticker, value in USD and hex color. Default positions are illustrative, without live market data.
items.brief: Integrate Holdings, a Motiqo circular segmented stock portfolio chart. Illustrative positions in Microsoft, Apple, NVIDIA, Alphabet, Amazon and Tesla total $61,800 against an $80,000 target. Reveal thin coloured arcs and interpolate the central USD value at a 60Hz target. Keep only a faint diffused inner surface; exclude decorative satellite circles and a visible purple crescent. Select a company through the ring or keyboard-accessible legend to inspect its position; selecting the centre restores total portfolio value. Expose holdings with name, ticker, value and color, target, scale, speed, thickness, gap, activity, compact and paused. No implied live quotes. Preserve bounded non-overlapping arcs, empty/full-circle handling, smooth position-size changes, reduced-motion static output, dark/light styles, matching miniature, offscreen suspension and complete RAF/observer/listener cleanup. SVG and React only.

items.title: Galaxy
items.hint: Move to tilt the galaxy. Arrow keys steer; Space pauses or resumes.
items.installNote: Copy galaxy.tsx, galaxy-math.ts and galaxy-shaders.ts into the same folder. React is the only dependency. Give its parent an explicit height.
items.brief: Integrate Galaxy, a Motiqo particle galaxy inspired by the supplied spiral reference. Render only the luminous galaxy on deep black: a brilliant white-violet core with a restrained vertical diffraction flare, many fine spiral streams, soft volumetric dust and scattered larger cyan stars. Project an inclined 3D disk with depth-dependent perspective. Fifty thousand seeded points form thin inward-advected filaments, flowing dust and larger circular stars with independent orbital speeds and radial drift. Narrow light pulses travel along selected arms from their tips into the core. Add dim background glints beyond the disk and preserve a clear vertical core flare. Use native WebGL2 point sprites with Gaussian additive light and a single static interleaved buffer; animate through vertex uniforms without per-frame CPU particle uploads or React renders. Smooth pointer/touch and keyboard input with exponential interpolation, keep the central core fixed, and bound the camera tilt. Provide count, speed, arms, tilt in degrees, glow, coreColor, edgeColor, compact and paused props. Render at a 60Hz target, including mobile; cap faster displays, use 18,000 points in thumbnails, and clamp DPR. Preserve a deterministic matching SVG fallback with rounded serialization for hydration, Space pause/resume, arrow-key steering, Home reset, reduced-motion static composition, offscreen/hidden suspension, context-loss restoration and complete shader/program/buffer/VAO/observer/listener/RAF cleanup. The galaxy artwork stays black in both site themes. Give the host a defined width and height.

items.title: Luma
items.description: A little light, ready to listen.
items.hint: A continuous particle wave. Space pauses or resumes it.
items.installNote: Copy luma.tsx, luma-math.ts and luma-shaders.ts into one folder. React is the only dependency. The greeting can be personalized with name and message.
items.brief: Integrate Luma, an authored Motiqo reconstruction of the particle wave in the supplied video. Include only a tall portrait black panel with a subtle semi-transparent 1px border and rounded top corners, extending past the bottom of its clipped stage. Centre two elegant light-weight text lines: Hey Robert, and How can I help you? Exclude the physical phone, notch, status bar, buttons and surrounding scene. Below the greeting a narrow fluid ribbon of sixteen thousand luminous particles continuously oscillates and advects horizontally. The filament dynamically pinches thin, while individually advected grains detach with finite lifetimes, inheriting emitter position and velocity at birth before drifting and fading into a soft plume. Use a coral-left to violet-right gradient. Use seeded interleaved attributes and native WebGL2 point sprites, with procedural vertex-shader motion and additive Gaussian light. Keep the CPU particle buffer static, without per-frame particle uploads or React renders. Target 60Hz requestAnimationFrame on desktop and mobile, with a frame-rate cap on faster displays; actual throughput depends on hardware. Configure name, message, count, speed, amplitude, glow, warmColor and coolColor. Preserve a matching SVG fallback, Space playback control, paused and static reduced motion, offscreen/hidden suspension, context-loss restoration, responsive panel sizing and full buffer/VAO/program/shader/observer/listener/RAF cleanup. The inner artwork remains black in both site themes.

items.title: Constellation
items.description: A stellar loom. Woven in dynamic perspective.
items.hint: Move to tilt the celestial sphere. Click or Space weaves star lines.
items.installNote: Install three, then copy constellation.tsx, constellation-math.ts and constellation-shaders.ts into one folder. Give the parent a defined height.
items.brief: Integrate Constellation, a Motiqo WebGL stellar sphere with 24,000 seeded particles, a volumetric interior, a dense luminous shell and prominent constellation stars connected by fine geodesic filaments. Preserve a circular silhouette with true perspective, depth-dependent brightness and point size. Dust drifts independently; highlights travel along curved threads. Use Three.js Points and LineSegments with static buffers and procedural shaders, additive soft circular sprites, cyan-white foreground light and subdued violet rear stars. Pointer input smoothly turns the sphere; click or Space sends a wave of light through it. Expose speed, intensity, nodes, density and accent, plus compact and paused. Target 60Hz, reduce thumbnail density, preserve SVG fallback, keyboard steering, reduced-motion static output, offscreen suspension, context restoration and full GPU/RAF/observer/listener cleanup. No solid rings, labels or locator reticles.

items.title: Aura
items.hint: Select the score to explore its colours. Move to shape the waves.
items.installNote: Copy aura.tsx, aura-math.ts and sphere-stage.tsx into one folder. React is the only dependency. The 0–5 score and risk thresholds are illustrative and can be adapted to your data.
items.brief: Integrate Aura, an authored Motiqo fluid score sphere inspired by the central sphere in the supplied video. Spherical harmonics animate a translucent membrane of fine wave contours and rim-weighted particles in real three-dimensional space. Show only Score, a large two-decimal number and Risk inside its centre, with no external menus, headings, categories or navigation. For the illustrative 0–5 scale higher scores have lower risk: above 3.75 Very low/blue, above 3 Low/green, above 2 Medium/amber, above 1 High/orange, otherwise Very high/red. Interpolate both the number and colour. Select the number to cycle sample scores, arrow keys adjust it, Home/End reach 0/5; support touch and keyboard. Supply score and onScoreChange for controlled data, or let the standalone component own its score. Expose speed, intensity, waves and density. Preserve included SVG fallback and styles, dark/light contrast, paused and static reduced motion, lower mobile density and 30fps, offscreen/hidden suspension and full cleanup. This is a visual score example, not a risk calculation engine.

items.title: Nexus
items.hint: Move to turn. Click or Space sends a pulse.
items.installNote: Copy nexus.tsx, nexus-math.ts and sphere-stage.tsx into one folder. React is the only dependency; geometry and scoped styles are included.
items.brief: Integrate Nexus, an authored Motiqo interpretation of the second sphere in the supplied video. Two linked Fibonacci shells and a seeded particle core turn independently in actual three-dimensional space. Build bounded nearest-neighbour connections once in world space, then project each layer with weak perspective and depth-dependent strokes and dots. Over a 24-second cycle the cage gently compresses and returns. Exponential Lerp steers the pointer axes and smoothly ramps click/touch/Space pulses. Arrow keys steer, Home resets. Configure speed, intensity, nodes, connections and strokeWidth. Preserve matching SVG fallback, neutral dark/light palettes, paused and static reduced motion, reduced mobile graph detail and 30fps, offscreen/hidden suspension and full cleanup. No external geometry or animation library is required.

items.title: Orbit
items.hint: Move to tilt. Click or Space expands the rings.
items.installNote: Copy orbit.tsx, orbit-math.ts and sphere-stage.tsx into one folder. React is the only dependency; scoped styles and arc geometry are included.
items.brief: Integrate Orbit, an authored Motiqo interpretation of the third sphere in the supplied video. Eight finely stroked concentric contours each comprise two open arcs, with independent alternating angular speeds and stable radii. Retain the reference’s almost frontal, minimal silhouette. Actual three-dimensional camera rotation softly tilts the rings around the pointer, with tiny plane relief and a smoothly ramped outward click/touch/Space pulse. Arrow keys steer, Home resets. Configure speed, intensity, rings, strokeWidth and spread. Use Canvas 2D with matching SVG fallback and included scoped styles. Preserve dark/light contrast, paused and static reduced motion, lower mobile tessellation and 30fps, offscreen/hidden suspension and full RAF/timer/listener/observer cleanup. React is the only dependency.

items.title: Halo
items.description: A little disorder. A quiet orbit.
items.hint: Move to tilt. Space holds the ordered globe.
items.installNote: Copy halo.tsx and halo-math.ts into one folder. Styles and deterministic particle geometry are included; React is the only dependency.
items.brief: Integrate Halo, an authored Motiqo particle globe inspired by the first sphere in the supplied video. A seeded spherical point cloud slowly rotates in three dimensions, then orders itself into dotted latitude bands and returns to the cloud over a 24-second cycle. Use shortest angular interpolation to keep every point on the spherical shell, fifth-order pattern transitions, depth-dependent dot size and opacity, and no connecting lines. A Canvas 2D renderer projects the actual 3D geometry without a WebGL dependency. Pointer and touch input use exponential Lerp to steer the axes and create a restrained local ripple. Arrow keys steer, Space holds the ordered globe, Home resets. Configure speed, intensity, count and dotSize. Preserve a matching SVG fallback, dark/light ink, paused and static reduced motion, lower mobile density and 30fps, offscreen/hidden suspension and full RAF/timer/listener/observer cleanup. Implement only this first globe.

items.title: District
items.hint: Explore a building. Click to keep its light.
items.installNote: Copy district.tsx, line-scene.tsx and line-solid.ts into one folder.
items.brief: Integrate District, an original Motiqo isometric city with sixteen independently authored stepped buildings, fine floor contours, pavements and roads. Use the shared orthographic SVG camera and solid painter for projected depth and occlusion. Hit-test projected visible building faces from front to back. Hover highlights the selected volume in coral with a smoothly positioned label; click or Space pins it, arrows browse, Home and End select the ends. Preserve exponential Lerp input, intensity and speed, reduced motion, touch, compact and paused props, offscreen suspension, sleep at rest and cleanup.

items.title: Pulse
items.hint: Explore the timeline. Space replays the line.
items.installNote: Copy pulse.tsx. Styling is included. The deterministic dataset is sample activity, not a live feed.
items.brief: Integrate Motiqo Pulse, a minimal dark activity card with a fine progressively drawn SVG line, subtle area fade, metric, time labels and cursor crosshair. Use deterministic sample data, a cubic reveal and slow evolving signal. Exponential Lerp smooths the pointer and crosshair presence; touch and arrow keys inspect the timeline, Space or Replay redraws it. Configure speed, amplitude and accent. Preserve compact and paused props, static reduced motion, 30fps small displays, hidden/offscreen suspension and complete RAF/observer/listener cleanup. React is the only dependency.

items.title: Event Horizon
items.hint: Move or touch to disturb the accretion disk.
items.installNote: Copy event-horizon.tsx, liquid-relic.tsx, liquid-particle-engine.ts and liquid-particle-shaders.ts into one folder. Save event-horizon.svg in public/media. The original black-hole artwork is Motiqo’s; retain the particle engine credit to Guglielmo Giannattasio.
items.brief: Integrate Motiqo Event Horizon, an authored black-hole illustration with a dark shadow, photon ring, lensed upper arc and copper/champagne accretion filaments. It uses the same credited GPU particle engine as Liquid Relic to dissolve and reconstruct the artwork around the hand. Preserve the original flow-map wake, curl advection and elastic return. Expose resting finish, strength, radius, particleSpread, liquid, returnSpeed and sculptureScale. Preserve Lerp pointer input, touch and keyboard, lower mobile density, static reduced motion, fallback image, visibility suspension and full GPU/listener/observer cleanup. Changing the artwork does not remove the engine attribution.

items.title: Liquid Relic
items.hint: Move or touch to dissolve the metal into particles.
items.installNote: Copy liquid-relic.tsx, liquid-particle-engine.ts and liquid-particle-shaders.ts into one folder. Save liquid-relic.svg under public/media, or supply your own CORS-readable src. Retain the engine credit to Guglielmo Giannattasio; the metallic Motiqo artwork and presentation are authored for Motiqo.
items.brief: Integrate Liquid Relic, Motiqo’s metallic emblem using the particle dynamics adapted from the supplied Sculpture Hero by Guglielmo Giannattasio. Keep its original GPU flow-map wake, curl-noise advection, complementary image/particle dissolve, velocity-stretched streaks and elastic return. Motiqo provides its own local artwork and minimal presentation, without the reference hero text or navigation. Configure strength, radius, particleSpread, liquid, returnSpeed, restStyle and sculptureScale. Preserve exponential Lerp pointer input, touch and keyboard stirring, paused/static reduced motion, lower mobile particle density and 30fps, visibility suspension, fresh canvases per lifecycle, static image fallback and complete GPU/listener/observer/RAF cleanup.

items.title: Crate
items.hint: Browse the records. Click to keep one.
items.installNote: Copy crate.tsx and crate-scene.ts into one folder. Install three and @types/three for TypeScript.
items.brief: Integrate Motiqo Crate, a shelf of solid vinyl records rendered with Three.js and an orthographic camera. Real depth testing keeps labels, grooves and shelf walls correctly occluded. A fixed pitch and bounded lean keep records separated. Exponential Lerp input drives critically damped springs to lift the nearest record. Click/tap or Space pins it; arrow keys browse and Home/End reach the ends. Configure count (3–10), intensity and speed. Preserve compact/paused props, reduced motion, sleeping at rest, visibility suspension, static fallback and full GPU/observer/listener cleanup.

items.title: Liquid Form
items.hint: Move or touch to turn and shape the metal.
items.installNote: Copy liquid-form.tsx and liquid-form-shaders.ts into one folder. No images or additional packages are required.
items.brief: Integrate Motiqo Liquid Form, an independently authored native WebGL2 sculpture. Signed-distance fields and ray marching generate Knot, Orbit and Bloom forms with procedural ridges, flowing surface deformation and metallic studio lighting. No sculpture image or external engine is used. Configure shape, liquidity, relief, scale and tint. Pointer position and presence use frame-independent exponential Lerp. Preserve keyboard/touch input, SVG fallback, static reduced motion, capped pixel density, sleeping at rest, offscreen/hidden-tab suspension and shader/buffer/context/listener cleanup.

items.title: Glow Nav
items.description: A little light, a clear direction.
items.hint: Hover or select a destination.
items.installNote: Copy glow-nav.tsx. Styling is scoped and included. Pass items, activeId and onSelect; optionally use renderLink for your framework router.
items.brief: Integrate Motiqo Glow Nav, a minimal navigation with Home, Projects, Search and Settings defaults. A single light field glides between destinations; pointer input, position, width and opacity use frame-independent exponential Lerp. There is no logo, divider or dropdown. Configure items with id/label/href, activeId, onSelect, duration and accent. Use renderLink for your framework router. Preserve native keyboard navigation, thin white focus, paused and reduced-motion support, and complete RAF/ResizeObserver/media-query cleanup. React is the only dependency.

items.title: Lantern
items.description: A quiet shell. A warmer centre.
items.hint: Move closer to reveal the light
items.installNote: Copy lantern.tsx, line-scene.tsx and line-solid.ts into one folder. React is the only dependency.
items.brief: Integrate Motiqo Lantern, eight curved metal petals on radial hinges around a warm spherical light. Copy lantern.tsx, line-scene.tsx and line-solid.ts together. Panels have exterior and interior walls, sealed edges and real thickness. A 2:1 orthographic camera and opaque depth-sorted surfaces hide the bulb when closed and reveal it as the petals open. Frame-independent Lerp and differently tuned damped springs respond to proximity; the glow follows the opening. Click/tap or Space holds it open, arrows steer and Home closes it. Preserve compact/paused props, smaller mobile opening, reduced motion, sleeping at rest, visibility suspension and cleanup. Only React is required.

items.title: Gyro
items.hint: Move to tilt. Click to turn.
items.installNote: Copy gyro.tsx, line-scene.tsx and line-solid.ts into one folder. All geometry and CSS are included; only React is required.
items.brief: Integrate Motiqo Gyro, three nested solid gimbal rings floating above a calibrated circular plinth, with no support posts or crossing rods. Copy gyro.tsx, line-scene.tsx and line-solid.ts together. The orthographic camera projects real annular surfaces; all faces and contour segments share depth ordering. Lerp input and separate damped oscillators tilt the rings around different axes. Click or Space advances the inner ring by one spring-driven quarter turn. Preserve arrow keys, Home reset, touch, minimal presentation, compact/paused props, reduced motion, 30fps narrow previews, sleeping at rest and complete cleanup. React is the only dependency.

items.title: Arbor
items.description: Rooted in place. Open to a little wind.
items.hint: Move or touch the branches
items.installNote: Copy arbor.tsx and line-scene.tsx into one folder. Only React is required; the shared stage includes scoped CSS and motion cleanup.
items.brief: Integrate Arbor, a Motiqo procedural line tree with anchored roots, curved branches, outlined leaves and locally illuminated edges. Copy arbor.tsx and line-scene.tsx from Source code into one folder. Exponential Lerp smooths the hand; damped oscillators propagate wind through parent-child branches. Preserve minimal presentation, touch gusts, arrow-key wind, compact and paused props, reduced motion, offscreen/hidden-tab suspension and cleanup. React is the only dependency.

items.title: Drawer
items.description: A little room for what comes next.
items.hint: Hover to open. Click to keep.
items.installNote: Copy drawer.tsx and line-scene.tsx into one folder. All cabinet geometry and motion are authored for Motiqo; no external figure library is required.
items.brief: Integrate Motiqo Drawer, an authored isometric cabinet with three chamfered trays, visible interiors, dividers, inset faces and restrained metal handles. Copy drawer.tsx and line-scene.tsx together. Hover opens the nearest tray with a damped spring; click/tap pins or releases it. Arrow keys select trays and Enter/Space pins them. Preserve Lerp input, scaled mobile movement, compact and paused props, reduced motion, viewport suspension and complete cleanup. React is the only dependency.

items.title: Tempo
items.hint: Move closer to slow time
items.installNote: Copy tempo.tsx, line-scene.tsx and line-solid.ts into one folder. The conveyor, solid portal and six spheres use an orthographic SVG camera; React is the only dependency.
items.brief: Integrate Motiqo Tempo, six shaded spheres travelling one way on a thin isometric conveyor. Copy tempo.tsx, line-scene.tsx and line-solid.ts. Use an orthonormal 45-degree azimuth and 30-degree elevation camera, real solid gate posts and lintel, opaque sphere silhouettes with front-only curved surface arcs, and depth ordering shared by spheres and gate. Each sphere grows in and shrinks out with a fifth-order envelope before wrapping invisibly; never reverse the procession. Hover smoothly dilates the clock and lifts only the nearest sphere. Click or Space keeps the slower tempo. Preserve Lerp pointer, touch/keyboard, paused/compact props, reduced motion, 30fps on narrow previews, viewport suspension and cleanup. React is the only dependency.

items.title: Pleat
items.hint: Move or touch to open the folds
items.installNote: Save the complete source as pleat.tsx. All geometry, motion and CSS are included; only React is required.
items.brief: Integrate Pleat, an original Motiqo SVG sculpture of 25 curved lamellae on an orthographic plinth. Copy the complete pleat.tsx source from the Code panel. Smooth pointer input with frame-rate independent exponential Lerp; neighbour-coupled damped springs open a local cavity and restore the sculpture. Preserve subtle champagne edge highlights, minimal presentation, touch and arrow-key interaction, compact and paused props, reduced motion, viewport and hidden-tab suspension, and complete listener/observer/RAF cleanup.

items.title: Gilded Signal
items.description: An engraved artifact. A little light, a lot of character.
items.hint: Move, drag or turn the card
items.installNote: Copy the four source files into the same folder. Install three and @types/three. Supply your backgroundSrc and emblemSrc assets; defaults use Motiqo’s media and SVG.
items.brief: Integrate Gilded Signal, an original Motiqo interpretation of an engraved holographic card. Copy all four source files from the Source code panel into one directory. Use React and Three.js (implementation built with 0.172.0), with SVGLoader from three/addons. A real beveled frame has an arched aperture, four-channel engraving atlas, foil shader, suspended extruded Motiqo SVG emblem and a separately printed reverse. The background combines supplied artwork, procedural smoke, additive filaments, dust and a GPU displacement field on desktop. Provide local backgroundSrc and emblemSrc paths. Keep pointer input scoped to the canvas, exponential interpolation, drag inertia, Turn control and host pause support, reduced motion, low mobile quality, viewport suspension and GPU cleanup. Only one card is implemented; there is no chapter navigation or card-to-card cable. compact enables the gallery version; paused follows the host control.

items.title: Silk Aperture
items.description: An architectural reveal. A slower kind of motion.
items.hint: Move or tap to reveal the light
items.installNote: Save as silk-aperture.tsx. Includes all CSS; only React is required. Minimal by default; control light with dawn or dusk.
items.brief: Integrate the original Motiqo Silk Aperture component. Copy the complete self-contained TSX implementation from its Code panel; it only requires React and includes scoped CSS. An illustrated arch is veiled by 23 metallic ribs that bow and spread with frame-rate independent exponential Lerp. Use obsidian, ivory, copper and sage. Keep the minimal view with only The Art of Being Elsewhere over the illustration. Place Dawn/Dusk controls outside the component and pass the controlled light prop. Preserve unique SVG IDs, reduced motion, pause support and cleanup. Rich header, subtitle and CTA are opt-in with minimal=false; do not invent a booking destination.
